vintagekinematics:block-handbooktext-vin:
The terminal owns the searchable item index for one connected Kinetic Warehouse. Place it first, then expand with wooden or reinforced warehouse cells. Right click to deposit, withdraw, search, sort, and resize the shared inventory view.

For construction, controls, safety, and recovery behavior, see Kinetic Warehouse.

Warehouse cells contribute shared capacity and do not contain private inventories. Wooden cells add 1,024 items each. Reinforced cells add 4,096 items in the same footprint. Place cells against the terminal or another linked cell by a full block face.

For the complete structure and removal rules, see Kinetic Warehouse.

A post Forge upgrade for a wooden warehouse cell, built with a machine bracket and pressed bands. Connect a shaft to the visible socket to power the entire linked Kinetic Warehouse. The warehouse begins operating at 16 RPM. Gear the input down to 16 RPM when practical: higher speed does not make storage transfers faster, but it does multiply the Drive Port’s SU demand.

Each physical capacity cell adds a small amount of load, so reinforced cells provide more capacity for less power. For the complete system, see Kinetic Warehouse.

A post Forge upgrade for a wooden warehouse cell, built with a copper funnel, belts, a machine bracket, and pressed bands. It feeds items from a belt or funnel at the visible opening into the linked warehouse. The input accepts one item per belt handoff and stops safely when the warehouse is full, unpowered, or unavailable.

Right click to configure five ghost-filter slots. An empty blacklist accepts everything; an empty whitelist accepts nothing. Exact and fuzzy matching use the same filter rules as VK funnels.

A post Forge upgrade for a wooden warehouse cell, built with a copper funnel, belts, a machine bracket, and pressed bands. It places filtered items onto a belt at the visible opening. Output is deliberately limited to four individual items per second and pauses when the belt is blocked.

Right click to configure five independent ghost-filter slots with the same blacklist, whitelist, exact, and fuzzy behavior as VK funnels.
